enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Extend legs. Flex feet. Turn onto back. Place arms at sides. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and taking a hot shower before the evening peak hours
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to heat. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn on tap. Wash face with water. Apply face wash. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Fry eggs. Flip eggs with spatula. Turn off stove. Take plate from cabinet. Put eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Open drawer. Take knife. Spread butter on bread. Open kettle lid. Fill kettle with water from tap. Close lid. Place kettle on base. Press switch to boil. Wait for water to boil. Pour boiling water into mug. Add coffee grounds. Stir with spoon. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Cut eggs. Eat eggs. Pick up bread. Eat bread. Pick up mug. Drink coffee. Finish eating. Stand up. Clear dishes. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing a bag for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Take out pants from drawer. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open closet. Take out bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Exit bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Open door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails, and meeting with partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make phone calls. Walk to meeting room. Greet partner. Shake hands. Sit down. Discuss program details. Take notes. Stand up. Walk back to desk. Open document. Type report. Save file. Print document.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to restaurant. Open door. Approach counter. Order food. Pay cashier. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw trash in bin. Walk back to office. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work at the nonprofit office: planning upcoming community events and updating program records
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open event planning software. Create new event. Enter event details. Set date and time. Add location. Invite participants. Send invitations. Open program records database. Update records. Save changes. Close software. Open email. Check for responses. Reply to inquiries. Make phone calls to vendors.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter apartment building. Walk to door. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Take plate. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select program. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower after the evening peak water-heater period
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to heat. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to catch up on personal tasks and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Reply to personal emails. Open document. Type notes. Save document. Close laptop. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Adjust volume.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit. Wipe mouth. Wash face with water. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Change into pajamas. Pull back blanket. Sit on bed. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Fall asleep.
